heading: Sixteenth replenishment

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: The United States Governor of the Fund is authorized to contribute on behalf of the United States $591,000,000 to the sixteenth replenishment of the resources of the Fund, subject to obtaining the necessary appropriations.

tree.heading: Authorization of appropriations
tree.text: In order to pay for the United States contribution provided for in subsection (a), there are authorized to be appropriated, without fiscal year limitation, $591,000,000 for payment by the Secretary of the Treasury.

sourceCredit: (Pub. L. 94–302, title II, § 227, as added Pub. L. 118–47, div. F, title VII, § 7070, Mar. 23, 2024, 138 Stat. 850.)
